output.subject: We've received your complaint about transfers in our app
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for getting in touch about your experience with our app.

You told us that last night you tried four times to move $500 from your savings to your checking account in the app, and each time you saw the message "Something went wrong. Try again later." You mentioned that nothing moved, and that you ended up driving to an ATM at 11pm instead. You've asked us to fix the app.

We're sorry for the frustration and inconvenience this caused, especially having to head out late at night when you expected to handle this from your phone.

We have received your complaint, and a specialist team is now reviewing it. They will respond to you within 10 business days.

If anything else comes up about these transfer attempts in the meantime, please reply to this message so the team can take it into account.

Thank you for taking the time to let us know.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Mode is acknowledge only, so the draft takes no position on the cause of the app errors and does not name the reviewing team.
Confirm that none of the four transfer attempts posted, either as duplicates or later, as the customer believes.
Check whether the ATM use generated any fees the customer may raise later.
Check whether there was a known app outage or transfer issue on the night described before the substantive reply.
The customer's only request is that the app be fixed; no refund or compensation was requested.
